details: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget reported a hack resulting in estimated losses between $351.6 million and $387.5 million. The attackers compromised wallet-backend infrastructure and spoofed transaction data. Bitget stated that customer funds and cold wallets remained secure, and Circle and Tether froze a hacker-controlled wallet containing approximately $318,000 in USDT and USDC. The incident has renewed discussions about the security of centralized exchange custody.
title: Bitget Suffers Major Hack, Customer Funds Reportedly Safe

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced a notable turnaround, moving from a cumulative $5.8 billion net outflow at their July low to approximately $800 million in net inflows for 2026. Separately, Bitcoin ETFs recorded roughly $2.4 billion in weekly inflows, marking their largest since October and pushing 2026 net flows positive. This indicates renewed institutional and retail interest in the asset class.
title: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs See Significant Inflows, Reversing Earlier Trend

details: Solana's significant Alpenglow upgrade has successfully reached its second public test network as of September 26, 2026. This upgrade aims to dramatically improve transaction finality, targeting approximately 150 milliseconds, a substantial reduction from the existing system's average of 12.8 seconds. This development could enhance Solana's appeal for high-speed decentralized applications.
title: Solana's Alpenglow Upgrade Hits Public Testnet, Targeting Faster Transactions

details: Zcash (ZEC) price saw an approximately 9% increase to $1,662.37, outperforming Bitcoin, driven by a broader market rotation into privacy-focused cryptocurrencies. This rally is narrative-driven, with other privacy coins like Dash also seeing significant gains. Additionally, Coinbase enabled Morpho loans for Zcash on September 26, allowing ZEC to be used as collateral, which could lead to a tightening of exchange supply.
title: Zcash Surges 9% Amid Renewed Interest in Privacy Coins and Coinbase Integration

details: Standard Chartered has released optimistic long-term price predictions, forecasting that Chainlink (LINK) could reach $200 and XRP (XRP) could hit $28 by the end of 2030. As of September 26, 2026, Chainlink was priced at $14, and XRP at $1.55. The bank also noted strong demand for XRP, with its US spot ETFs recording approximately $76 million in inflows over four days.
title: Standard Chartered Forecasts Bullish Price Targets for Chainlink and XRP by 2030

details: Vitalik Buterin, at the 12th Global Blockchain Summit, revealed Ethereum's plans for new privacy upgrades, including "private reads, writes, and proving." This initiative aims to limit metadata exposure, as Buterin stated that basic pseudonymity is no longer sufficient to protect users due to AI's ability to correlate blockchain activity across wallets. The strategy leverages zero-knowledge technology to give users more control over their data while maintaining transaction verifiability.
title: Ethereum Explores AI-Driven Privacy Upgrades to Enhance User Protection

details: ARK Invest, led by Cathie Wood, is tokenizing its ARK Venture Fund by partnering with Securitize and placing it on the Ethereum blockchain. The fund, valued at approximately $1.3 billion, holds stakes in prominent private companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and SpaceX. This move allows eligible investors to gain exposure to the fund's portfolio through digital tokens, highlighting a growing trend of institutional adoption of blockchain technology for traditional assets.
title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest Tokenizes Venture Fund on Ethereum
